page_root: original batch inventory, directory identity, complete file identities and exact byte hashes
scope_only: unresolved; no inferred nonapplication; no replay or invented intent
source_lost: terminal history, unresolved effect; operator attention required
new_effect_gate: all prior records in selected directory resolved and one unused record slot
foreign_records: validated and counted, not attributed to current batch; unresolved records still block
allowed_new_files: only selected new scope, native intent and native outcome
history_recheck: old membership, file identity and bytes at effect and publication boundaries
